sections.title: Roost Laptop Stand
content: Con un diseño ultraligero, el Roost Laptop Stand eleva tu pantalla entre 6.5 y 12.5 pulgadas para mejorar postura y reducir la tensión ocular. Sus innovadores materiales de alta rigidez aseguran que tu pantalla se mantenga estable, eliminando cualquier movimiento incómodo. Olvídate de los soportes tambaleantes: este proporciona una plataforma rígida, ideal para configuraciones de escritorio constantes o para viajar.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 100 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Lift to Eye Level - Raise your screen to a natural eye-line to reduce hunching and improve posture; external keyboard/mouse recommended. Screen Lift: 6.5–12.5″

Set-and-Go Simplicity - Built for speed and consistency, the V3 uses a secure, two-handed lock to set your height. It pops open in one motion to your memorized setting, making it ideal for a consistent desk setup or travel
Zero Flex, Perfectly Still Screen - No more screen shake from wobbly and rotating-base stands. The Roost’s interlocking truss frame and high-stiffness materials create an ultra-rigid platform.
Ultralight & Travel-Ready - Weighing only 6 oz, the Roost packs impossibly thin to live in your bag.

Universal Fit with Patented PivotGrips - Self-adjusting grips automatically adapt and lock onto any 12–18″ laptop for a confident, non-slip hold. As a US-Based company, we are dedicated to lasting quality and responsive support.

sections.title: Serafim Keybo
content: Lo que nadie te dice del Serafim Keybo es que transforma gestos en comandos precisos con su air mouse. Además, su duración de batería de 100 horas te mantiene conectado durante semanas.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 40 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: Classic Tactile Feel & Innovative Key Design:Experience the iconic, satisfying snap of classic mobile keyboards with our unique solid-state keycaps. They deliver a precise and responsive typing feel that far surpasses soft silicone keys, making every keystroke both efficient and enjoyable

Elevate your control beyond a standard keyboard. This all-in-one remote features an intuitive air mouse that turns natural hand movements into precise cursor control, offering a wider range of motion than a traditional touchpad. Coupled with responsive dedicated click buttons, it delivers seamless, touchpad-rivaling accuracy for effortless media browsing, dynamic presentations, or relaxed living room navigation

100-Hour Battery Life & USB-C Fast Charging:Power through weeks of use on a single charge. With an astonishing 100-hour battery life (backlight off), it outlasts standard wireless mini keyboard by over 5x. The fast-charging USB-C port provides hours of power in just minutes, so you’re never left waiting

Dual-Mode Connectivity & Smart RGB Backlight:Mini wireless keyboard switch effortlessly between Bluetooth 5.0 and a lag-free 2.4GHz USB receiver. Connect up to multi-device simultaneously and switch between them instantly. The smart ambient light sensor automatically activates the 7-color RGB backlight in low light, blending style with perfect visibility

Ultra-Portable & Universally Compatible:Mini bluetooth keyboard weighing only 84g and as slim as a remote, it slides effortlessly into your pocket or bag. Fully compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, Smart TVs, and Linux, it’s the single, go-to keyboard for all your devices—at home, in the office, or on the go
